figs.name: correction-factor-in-calibration-method-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose direct, nearest, averaging or linear interpolation correction method
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to pick one of the four ways to apply a correction factor from a calibration certificate, then add it to the reading.
figs.after_h2: 4 Ways to Apply Correction Factors in a Calibration Certificate
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to choose the correction factor method from a calibration certificate</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Correction Method Should You Use?</text>
<rect x="80" y="55" width="340" height="46" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250.0" y="84.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reading taken on the UUC</text>
<line x1="250" y1="101" x2="250" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="250,112.0 420.0,160 250,208.0 80.0,160" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="155.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Exact point on</text>
<text x="250" y="177.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">certificate?</text>
<line x1="420" y1="160" x2="468" y2="160" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="444" y="150" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="128" width="280" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="154.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Direct use</text>
<text x="610.0" y="178.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CF at 20 °C = 0.045</text>
<line x1="750" y1="160" x2="780" y2="160" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polygon points="250,242.0 420.0,290 250,338.0 80.0,290" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="285.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wide tolerance or</text>
<text x="250" y="307.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">low resolution?</text>
<line x1="420" y1="290" x2="468" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="444" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="258" width="280" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="284.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Nearest point</text>
<text x="610.0" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">take the closest CF</text>
<line x1="750" y1="290" x2="780" y2="290" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polygon points="250,372.0 420.0,420 250,468.0 80.0,420" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="415.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reading exactly</text>
<text x="250" y="437.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">midway?</text>
<line x1="420" y1="420" x2="468" y2="420" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="444" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="388" width="280" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="414.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Averaging</text>
<text x="610.0" y="438.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CF at 25 = 0.054</text>
<line x1="750" y1="420" x2="780" y2="420" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="250" y1="208" x2="250" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="230" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="250" y1="338" x2="250" y2="370" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="360" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="250" y1="468" x2="250" y2="503" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="492" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="80" y="505" width="340" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250.0" y="529.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Linear interpolation</text>
<text x="250.0" y="553.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CF at 37 = 0.0812</text>
<line x1="780" y1="160" x2="780" y2="535" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="780" y1="535" x2="762" y2="535" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="420" y1="535" x2="458" y2="535" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="460" y="500" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#be185d" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="529.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Corrected reading</text>
<text x="610.0" y="554.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= Reading + CF</text>
</svg>
